audit_scope: Read-only metadata/receipt comparison and streamed binary SHA256 checks; no analysis reruns, new telescope HTTP, RNG, HDF5 numerical decoding or numerical NPZ parsing.
Output geometry, complete rows, selected fixed profile ancestry, bounds, resource envelopes and code/source pins checked independently from JSON evidence.
remaining_review_scope: PNG visual rendering review is separate; binary hashes alone do not verify plotting quality.
No independent numerical rescoring or recovery/FAP/flux/sky-significance qualification follows from this integrity audit.
Original source whole-file MD5/SHA is not verified; exact source-range hashes and ETag/file-size identities are retained.
HTTP status/effective-URL checks were enforced by the frozen reader; per-request receipts store checked headers and completion markers, rather than separate response-status/effective-URL fields.
Received accounting is application-body accounting, excluding wire/header traffic and separately restored dependency/cache bytes.
